passages.label: Mart. 7.1.1
passages.text: Accipe belligerae crudum thoraca Minervae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.1.2
passages.text: Ipsa Medusaeae quem timet ira comae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.1.3
passages.text: Dum vacat, haec, Caesar, poterit lorica vocari:

passages.label: Mart. 7.1.4
passages.text: Pectore cum sacro sederit, aegis erit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.1
passages.text: Invia Sarmaticis domini lorica sagittis

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.2
passages.text: Et Martis Getico tergore fida magis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.3
passages.text: Quam vel ad Aetolae securam cuspidis ictus

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.4
passages.text: Texuit innumeri lubricus unguis apri:

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.5
passages.text: Felix sorte tua, sacrum cui tangere pectus

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.6
passages.text: Fas erit et nostri mente calere dei.

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.7
passages.text: I comes et magnos inlaesa merere triumphos

passages.label: Mart. 7.2.8
passages.text: Palmataeque ducem, sed cito, redde togae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.3.1
passages.text: Cur non mitto meos tibi, Pontiliane, libellos?

passages.label: Mart. 7.3.2
passages.text: Ne mihi tu mittas, Pontiliane, tuos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.4.1
passages.text: Esset, Castrice, cum mali coloris,

passages.label: Mart. 7.4.2
passages.text: Versus scribere coepit Oppianus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.1
passages.text: Si desiderium, Caesar, populique patrumque

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.2
passages.text: Respicis et Latiae gaudia vera togae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.3
passages.text: Redde deum votis poscentibus. Invidet hosti

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.4
passages.text: Roma suo, veniat laurea multa licet:

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.5
passages.text: Terrarum dominum propius videt ille, tuoque

passages.label: Mart. 7.5.6
passages.text: Terretur vultu barbarus et fruitur.

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.1
passages.text: Ecquid Hyperboreis ad nos conversus ab oris

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.2
passages.text: Ausonias Caesar iam parat ire vias?

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.3
passages.text: Certus abest auctor, sed vox hoc nuntiat omnis:

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.4
passages.text: Credo tibi, verum dicere, Fama, soles.

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.5
passages.text: Publica victrices testantur gaudia chartae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.6
passages.text: Martia laurigera cuspide pila virent.

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.7
passages.text: Rursus, io, magnos clamat tibi Roma triumphos

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.8
passages.text: Invictusque tua, Caesar, in urbe sonas.

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.9
passages.text: Sed iam laetitiae quo sit fiducia maior,

passages.label: Mart. 7.6.10
passages.text: Sarmaticae laurus nuntius ipse veni.

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.1
passages.text: Hiberna quamvis Arctos et rudis Peuce

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.2
passages.text: Et ungularum pulsibus calens Hister

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.3
passages.text: Fractusque cornu iam ter inprobo Rhenus

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.4
passages.text: Teneat domantem regna perfidae gentis

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.5
passages.text: Te, summe mundi rector et parens orbis:

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.6
passages.text: Abesse nostris non tamen potes votis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.7
passages.text: Illic et oculis et animis sumus, Caesar,

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.8
passages.text: Adeoque mentes omnium tenes unus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.9
passages.text: Ut ipsa magni turba nesciat Circi,

passages.label: Mart. 7.7.10
passages.text: Utrumne currat Passerinus an Tigris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.1
passages.text: Nunc hilares, si quando mihi, nunc ludite, Musae:

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.2
passages.text: Victor ab Odrysio redditur orbe deus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.3
passages.text: Certa facis populi tu primus vota, December:

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.4
passages.text: Iam licet ingenti dicere voce 'Venit!'

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.5
passages.text: Felix sorte tua! Poteras non cedere Iano,

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.6
passages.text: Gaudia si nobis, quae dabit ille, dares.

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.7
passages.text: Festa coronatus ludet convicia miles,

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.8
passages.text: Inter laurigeros cum comes ibit equos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.9
passages.text: Fas audire iocos levioraque carmina, Caesar,

passages.label: Mart. 7.8.10
passages.text: Et tibi, si lusus ipse triumphus amat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.9.1
passages.text: Cum sexaginta numeret Cascellius annos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.9.2
passages.text: Ingeniosus homo est: quando disertus erit?

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.1
passages.text: Pedicatur Eros, fellat Linus: Ole, quid ad te,

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.2
passages.text: De cute quid faciant ille vel ille sua?

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.3
passages.text: Centenis futuit Matho milibus: Ole, quid ad te?

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.4
passages.text: Non tu propterea, sed Matho pauper erit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.5
passages.text: In lucem cenat Sertorius: Ole, quid ad te,

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.6
passages.text: Cum liceat tota stertere nocte tibi?

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.7
passages.text: Septingenta Tito debet Lupus: Ole, quid ad te?

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.8
passages.text: Assem ne dederis crediderisve Lupo.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.9
passages.text: Illud dissimulas, ad te quod pertinet, Ole,

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.10
passages.text: Quodque magis curae convenit esse tuae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.11
passages.text: Pro togula debes: hoc ad te pertinet, Ole.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.12
passages.text: Quadrantem nemo iam tibi credit: et hoc.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.13
passages.text: Uxor moecha tibi est: hoc ad te pertinet, Ole.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.14
passages.text: Poscit iam dotem filia grandis: et hoc.

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.15
passages.text: Dicere quindecies poteram, quod pertinet ad te:

passages.label: Mart. 7.10.16
passages.text: Sed quid agas, ad me pertinet, Ole, nihil.

passages.label: Mart. 7.11.1
passages.text: Cogis me calamo manuque nostra

passages.label: Mart. 7.11.2
passages.text: Emendare meos, Pudens, libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.11.3
passages.text: O quam me nimium probas amasque,

passages.label: Mart. 7.11.4
passages.text: Qui vis archetypas habere nugas!

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.1
passages.text: Sic me fronte legat dominus, Faustine, serena

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.2
passages.text: Excipiatque meos, qua solet aure, iocos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.3
passages.text: Ut mea nec, iuste quos odit, pagina laesit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.4
passages.text: Et mihi de nullo fama rubore placet.

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.5
passages.text: Quid prodest, cupiant cum quidam nostra videri,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.6
passages.text: Si qua Lycambeo sanguine tela madent,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.7
passages.text: Vipereumque vomat nostro sub nomine virus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.8
passages.text: Qui Phoebi radios ferre diemque negat?

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.9
passages.text: Ludimus innocui: scis hoc bene: iuro potentis

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.10
passages.text: Per genium Famae Castaliumque gregem

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.11
passages.text: Perque tuas aures, magni mihi numinis instar,

passages.label: Mart. 7.12.12
passages.text: Lector inhumana liber ab invidia.

passages.label: Mart. 7.13.1
passages.text: Dum Tiburtinis albescere solibus audit

passages.label: Mart. 7.13.2
passages.text: Antiqui dentis fusca Lycoris ebur,

passages.label: Mart. 7.13.3
passages.text: Venit in Herculeos colles. Quid Tiburis alti

passages.label: Mart. 7.13.4
passages.text: Aura valet! Parvo tempore nigra redit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.1
passages.text: Accidit infandum nostrae scelus, Aule, puellae;

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.2
passages.text: Amisit lusus deliciasque suas:

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.3
passages.text: Non quales teneri ploravit amica Catulli

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.4
passages.text: Lesbia, nequitiis passeris orba sui,

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.5
passages.text: Vel Stellae cantata meo quas flevit Ianthis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.6
passages.text: Cuius in Elysio nigra columba volat:

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.7
passages.text: Lux mea non capitur nugis neque moribus istis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.8
passages.text: Nec dominae pectus talia damna movent:

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.9
passages.text: Bis denos puerum numerantem perdidit annos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.14.10
passages.text: Mentula cui nondum sesquipedalis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.1
passages.text: Quis puer hic nitidis absistit Ianthidos undis?

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.2
passages.text: Effugit dominam Naida numquid Hylas?

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.3
passages.text: O bene, quod silva colitur Tirynthius ista

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.4
passages.text: Et quod amatrices tam prope servat aquas!

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.5
passages.text: Securus licet hos fontes, Argynne, ministres:

passages.label: Mart. 7.15.6
passages.text: Nil facient Nymphae: ne velit ipse, cave.

passages.label: Mart. 7.16.1
passages.text: Aera domi non sunt, superest hoc, Regule, solum,

passages.label: Mart. 7.16.2
passages.text: Ut tua vendamus munera: numquid emis?

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.1
passages.text: Ruris bibliotheca delicati,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.2
passages.text: Vicinam videt unde lector urbem,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.3
passages.text: Inter carmina sanctiora si quis

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.4
passages.text: Lascivae fuerit locus Thaliae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.5
passages.text: Hos nido licet inseras vel imo,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.6
passages.text: Septem quos tibi misimus libellos

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.7
passages.text: Auctoris calamo sui notatos:

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.8
passages.text: Haec illis pretium facit litura.

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.9
passages.text: At tu munere dedicata parvo

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.10
passages.text: Quae cantaberis orbe nota toto,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.11
passages.text: Pignus pectoris hoc mei tuere,

passages.label: Mart. 7.17.12
passages.text: Iuli bibliotheca Martialis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.1
passages.text: Cum tibi sit facies, de qua nec femina possit

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.2
passages.text: Dicere, cum corpus nulla litura notet,

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.3
passages.text: Cur te tam rarus cupiat repetatque fututor,

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.4
passages.text: Miraris? Vitium est non leve, Galla, tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.5
passages.text: Accessi quotiens ad opus mixtisque movemur

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.6
passages.text: Inguinibus, cunnus non tacet, ipsa taces.

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.7
passages.text: Di facerent, ut tu loquereris et ille taceret:

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.8
passages.text: Offendor cunni garrulitate tui.

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.9
passages.text: Pedere te mallem: namque hoc nec inutile dicit

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.10
passages.text: Symmachus et risum res movet ista simul:

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.11
passages.text: Quis ridere potest fatui poppysmata cunni?

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.12
passages.text: Cum sonat hic, cui non mentula mensque cadit?

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.13
passages.text: Dic aliquid saltem clamosoque obstrepe cunno,

passages.label: Mart. 7.18.14
passages.text: Et si adeo muta es, disce vel inde loqui.

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.1
passages.text: Fragmentum quod vile putas et inutile lignum,

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.2
passages.text: Haec fuit ignoti prima carina maris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.3
passages.text: Quam nec Cyaneae quondam potuere ruinae

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.4
passages.text: Frangere nec Scythici tristior ira freti,

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.5
passages.text: Saecula vicerunt: sed quamvis cesserit annis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.19.6
passages.text: Sanctior est salva parva tabella rate.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.1
passages.text: Nihil est miserius neque gulosius Santra.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.2
passages.text: Rectam vocatus cum cucurrit ad cenam,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.3
passages.text: Quam tot diebus noctibusque captavit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.4
passages.text: Ter poscit apri glandulas, quater lumbum,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.5
passages.text: Et utramque coxam leporis et duos armos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.6
passages.text: Nec erubescit peierare de turdo

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.7
passages.text: Et ostreorum rapere lividos cirros.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.8
passages.text: Buccis placentae sordidam linit mappam;

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.9
passages.text: Illic et uvae conlocantur ollares

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.10
passages.text: Et Punicorum pauca grana malorum

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.11
passages.text: Et excavatae pellis indecens volvae

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.12
passages.text: Et lippa ficus debilisque boletus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.13
passages.text: Sed mappa cum iam mille rumpitur furtis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.14
passages.text: Rosos tepenti spondylos sinu condit

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.15
passages.text: Et devorato capite turturem truncum.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.16
passages.text: Colligere longa turpe nec putat dextra,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.17
passages.text: Analecta quidquid et canes reliquerunt.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.18
passages.text: Nec esculenta sufficit gulae praeda,

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.19
passages.text: Mixto lagonam replet ad pedes vino.

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.20
passages.text: Haec per ducentas cum domum tulit scalas

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.21
passages.text: Seque obserata clusit anxius cella

passages.label: Mart. 7.20.22
passages.text: Gulosus ille, postero die vendit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.21.1
passages.text: Haec est illa dies, magni quae conscia partus

passages.label: Mart. 7.21.2
passages.text: Lucanum populis et tibi, Polla, dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.21.3
passages.text: Heu! Nero crudelis nullaque invisior umbra,

passages.label: Mart. 7.21.4
passages.text: Debuit hoc saltem non licuisse tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 7.22.1
passages.text: Vatis Apollinei magno memorabilis ortu

passages.label: Mart. 7.22.2
passages.text: Lux redit: Aonidum turba, favete sacris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.22.3
passages.text: Haec meruit, cum te terris, Lucane, dedisset,

passages.label: Mart. 7.22.4
passages.text: Mixtus Castaliae Baetis ut esset aquae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.23.1
passages.text: Phoebe, veni, sed quantus eras, cum bella tonanti

passages.label: Mart. 7.23.2
passages.text: Ipse dares Latiae plectra secunda lyrae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.23.3
passages.text: Quid tanta pro luce precer? Tu, Polla, maritum

passages.label: Mart. 7.23.4
passages.text: Saepe colas et se sentiat ille coli.

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.1
passages.text: Cum Iuvenale meo quae me committere temptas,

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.2
passages.text: Quid non audebis, perfida lingua, loqui?

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.3
passages.text: Te fingente nefas Pyladen odisset Orestes,

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.4
passages.text: Thesea Pirithoi destituisset amor,

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.5
passages.text: Tu Siculos fratres et maius nomen Atridas

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.6
passages.text: Et Ledae poteras dissociare genus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.7
passages.text: Hoc tibi pro meritis et talibus inprecor ausis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.24.8
passages.text: Ut facias illud, quod, puto, lingua, facis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.1
passages.text: Dulcia cum tantum scribas epigrammata semper

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.2
passages.text: Et cerussata candidiora cute,

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.3
passages.text: Nullaque mica salis nec amari fellis in illis

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.4
passages.text: Gutta sit, o demens, vis tamen illa legi!

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.5
passages.text: Nec cibus ipse iuvat morsu fraudatus aceti,

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.6
passages.text: Nec grata est facies, cui gelasinus abest.

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.7
passages.text: Infanti melimela dato fatuasque mariscas:

passages.label: Mart. 7.25.8
passages.text: Nam mihi, quae novit pungere, Chia sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.1
passages.text: Apollinarem conveni meum, Scazon;

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.2
passages.text: Et si vacabit—ne molestus accedas—,

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.3
passages.text: Hoc qualecumque, cuius aliqua pars ipse est,

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.4
passages.text: Dabis: haec facetum carmen inbuant aures.

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.5
passages.text: Si te receptum fronte videris tota,

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.6
passages.text: Noto rogabis ut favore sustentet.

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.7
passages.text: Quanto mearum, scis, amore nugarum

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.8
passages.text: Flagret: nec ipse plus amare te possum.

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.9
passages.text: Contra malignos esse si cupis tutus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.26.10
passages.text: Apollinarem conveni meum, Scazon.

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.1
passages.text: Tuscae glandis aper populator et ilice multa

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.2
passages.text: Iam piger, Aetolae fama secunda ferae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.3
passages.text: Quem meus intravit splendenti cuspide Dexter,

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.4
passages.text: Praeda iacet nostris invidiosa focis:

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.5
passages.text: Pinguescant madido laeti nidore penates

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.6
passages.text: Flagret et exciso festa culina iugo.

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.7
passages.text: Sed cocus ingentem piperis consumet acervum

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.8
passages.text: Addet et arcano mixta Falerna garo:

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.9
passages.text: Ad dominum redeas, noster te non capit ignis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.27.10
passages.text: Conturbator aper: vilius esurio.

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.1
passages.text: Sic Tiburtinae crescat tibi silva Dianae

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.2
passages.text: Et properet caesum saepe redire nemus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.3
passages.text: Nec Tartesiacis Pallas tua, Fusce, trapetis

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.4
passages.text: Cedat et inmodici dent bona musta lacus;

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.5
passages.text: Sic fora mirentur, sic te palatia laudent,

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.6
passages.text: Excolat et geminas plurima palma fores:

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.7
passages.text: Otia dum medius praestat tibi parva December,

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.8
passages.text: Exige, sed certa, quos legis, aure iocos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.9
passages.text: 'Scire libet verum? res est haec ardua.' Sed tu

passages.label: Mart. 7.28.10
passages.text: Quod tibi vis dici, dicere, Fusce, potes.

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.1
passages.text: Thestyle, Victoris tormentum dulce Voconi,

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.2
passages.text: Quo nemo est toto notior orbe puer,

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.3
passages.text: Sic etiam positis formosus amere capillis

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.4
passages.text: Et placeat vati nulla puella tuo:

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.5
passages.text: Paulisper domini doctos sepone libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.6
passages.text: Carmina Victori dum lego parva tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.7
passages.text: Et Maecenati, Maro cum cantaret Alexin,

passages.label: Mart. 7.29.8
passages.text: Nota tamen Marsi fusca Melaenis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.30.1
passages.text: Das Parthis, das Germanis, das, Caelia, Dacis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.30.2
passages.text: Nec Cilicum spernis Cappadocumque toros;

passages.label: Mart. 7.30.3
passages.text: Et tibi de Pharia Memphiticus urbe fututor

passages.label: Mart. 7.30.4
passages.text: Navigat, a rubris et niger Indus aquis;

passages.label: Mart. 7.30.5

passages.text: Sic tenet absentes nostros cantatque libellos,

passages.text: Ut pereat chartis littera nulla meis:

passages.text: Denique, si vellet, poterat scripsisse videri;

passages.label: Mart. 7.51.10
passages.text: Sed famae mavult ille favere meae.

passages.text: Hunc licet a decuma—neque enim satis ante vacabit—

passages.text: Vix puto triginta nummorum tota fuisse

passages.text: Quanto commodius nullo mihi ferre labore

passages.label: Mart. 7.61.7
passages.text: Stringitur in densa nec caeca novacula turba,

passages.label: Mart. 7.61.8
passages.text: Occupat aut totas nigra popina vias.

passages.label: Mart. 7.61.9
passages.text: Tonsor, copo, cocus, lanius sua limina servant.

passages.label: Mart. 7.61.10
passages.text: Nunc Roma est, nuper magna taberna fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.1
passages.text: Reclusis foribus grandes percidis, Amille,

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.2
passages.text: Et te deprendi, cum facis ista, cupis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.3
passages.text: Ne quid liberti narrent servique paterni

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.4
passages.text: Et niger obliqua garrulitate cliens.

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.5
passages.text: Non pedicari se qui testatur, Amille,

passages.label: Mart. 7.62.6
passages.text: Illud saepe facit, quod sine teste facit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.1
passages.text: Perpetui numquam moritura volumina Sili

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.2
passages.text: Qui legis et Latia carmina digna toga,

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.3
passages.text: Pierios tantum vati placuisse recessus

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.4
passages.text: Credis et Aoniae Bacchica serta comae?

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.5
passages.text: Sacra coturnati non attigit ante Maronis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.6
passages.text: Implevit magni quam Ciceronis opus:

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.7
passages.text: Hunc miratur adhuc centum gravis hasta virorum,

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.8
passages.text: Hunc loquitur grato plurimus ore cliens.

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.9
passages.text: Postquam bis senis ingentem fascibus annum

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.10
passages.text: Rexerat, adserto qui sacer orbe fuit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.11
passages.text: Emeritos Musis et Phoebo tradidit annos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.63.12
passages.text: Proque suo celebrat nunc Helicona foro.

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.1
passages.text: Qui tonsor fueras tota notissimus urbe,

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.2
passages.text: Et post hoc dominae munere factus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.3
passages.text: Sicanias urbes Aetnaeaque regna petisti,

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.4
passages.text: Cinname, cum fugeres tristia iura fori.

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.5
passages.text: Qua nunc arte graves tolerabis inutilis annos?

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.6
passages.text: Quid facit infelix et fugitiva quies?

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.7
passages.text: Non rhetor, non grammaticus ludive magister,

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.8
passages.text: Non Cynicus, non tu Stoicus esse potes,

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.9
passages.text: Vendere nec vocem Siculis plausumque theatris:

passages.label: Mart. 7.64.10
passages.text: Quod superest, iterum, Cinname, tonsor eris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.65.1
passages.text: Lis te bis decumae numerantem frigora brumae

passages.label: Mart. 7.65.2
passages.text: Conterit una tribus, Gargiliane, foris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.65.3
passages.text: A miser et demens! viginti litigat annis

passages.label: Mart. 7.65.4
passages.text: Quisquam, cui vinci, Gargiliane, licet?

passages.label: Mart. 7.66.1
passages.text: Heredem Fabius Labienum ex asse reliquit:

passages.label: Mart. 7.66.2
passages.text: Plus meruisse tamen se Labienus ait.

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.1
passages.text: Pedicat pueros tribas Philaenis

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.2
passages.text: Et tentigine saevior mariti

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.3
passages.text: Undenas dolat in die puellas.

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.4
passages.text: Harpasto quoque subligata ludit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.5
passages.text: Et flavescit haphe, gravesque draucis

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.6
passages.text: Halteras facili rotat lacerto,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.7
passages.text: Et putri lutulenta de palaestra

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.8
passages.text: Uncti verbere vapulat magistri:

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.9
passages.text: Nec cenat prius aut recumbit ante,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.10
passages.text: Quam septem vomuit meros deunces;

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.11
passages.text: Ad quos fas sibi tunc putat redire,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.12
passages.text: Cum coloephia sedecim comedit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.13
passages.text: Post haec omnia cum libidinatur,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.14
passages.text: Non fellat—putat hoc parum virile—,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.15
passages.text: Sed plane medias vorat puellas.

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.16
passages.text: Di mentem tibi dent tuam, Philaeni,

passages.label: Mart. 7.67.17
passages.text: Cunnum lingere quae putas virile.

passages.label: Mart. 7.68.1
passages.text: Commendare meas, Instanti Rufe, Camenas

passages.label: Mart. 7.68.2
passages.text: Parce precor socero: seria forsan amat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.68.3
passages.text: Quod si lascivos admittit et ille libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.68.4
passages.text: Haec ego vel Curio Fabricioque legam.

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.1
passages.text: Haec est illa tibi promissa Theophila, Cani,

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.2
passages.text: Cuius Cecropia pectora dote madent:

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.3
passages.text: Hanc sibi iure petat magni senis Atticus hortus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.4
passages.text: Nec minus esse suam Stoica turba velit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.5
passages.text: Vivet opus quodcumque per has emiseris aures:

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.6
passages.text: Tam non femineum nec populare sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.7
passages.text: Non tua Pantaenis nimium se praeferat illi,

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.8
passages.text: Quamvis Pierio sit bene nota choro.

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.9
passages.text: Carmina fingentem Sappho laudabat amatrix:

passages.label: Mart. 7.69.10
passages.text: Castior haec, et non doctior illa fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.70.1
passages.text: Ipsarum tribadum tribas, Philaeni,

passages.label: Mart. 7.70.2
passages.text: Recte, quam futuis, vocas amicam.

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.1
passages.text: Ficosa est uxor, ficosus et ipse maritus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.2
passages.text: Filia ficosa est et gener atque nepos,

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.3
passages.text: Nec dispensator nec vilicus ulcere turpi

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.4
passages.text: Nec rigidus fossor, sed nec arator eget.

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.5
passages.text: Cum sint ficosi pariter iuvenesque senesque,

passages.label: Mart. 7.71.6
passages.text: Res mira est, ficos non habet unus ager.

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.1
passages.text: Gratus sic tibi, Paule, sit December,

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.2
passages.text: Nec vani triplices brevesque mappae

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.3
passages.text: Nec turis veniant leves selibrae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.4
passages.text: Sed lances ferat et scyphos avorum

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.5
passages.text: Aut grandis reus aut potens amicus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.6
passages.text: Seu quod te potius iuvat capitque;

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.7
passages.text: Sic vincas Noviumque Publiumque

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.8
passages.text: Mandris et vitreo latrone clusos;

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.9
passages.text: Sic palmam tibi de trigone nudo

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.10
passages.text: Unctae det favor arbiter coronae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.11
passages.text: Nec laudet Polybi magis sinistras:

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.12
passages.text: Si quisquam mea dixerit malignus

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.13
passages.text: Atro carmina quae madent veneno,

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.14
passages.text: Ut vocem mihi commodes patronam

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.15
passages.text: Et quantum poteris, sed usque, clames:

passages.label: Mart. 7.72.16
passages.text: 'Non scripsit meus ista Martialis.'

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.1
passages.text: Esquiliis domus est, domus est tibi colle Dianae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.2
passages.text: Et tua patricius culmina vicus habet;

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.3
passages.text: Hinc viduae Cybeles, illinc sacraria Vestae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.4
passages.text: Inde novum, veterem prospicis inde Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.5
passages.text: Dic, ubi conveniam, dic, qua te parte requiram:

passages.label: Mart. 7.73.6
passages.text: Quisquis ubique habitat, Maxime, nusquam habitat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.1
passages.text: Cyllenes caelique decus, facunde minister,

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.2
passages.text: Aurea cui torto virga dracone viret:

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.3
passages.text: Sic tibi lascivi non desit copia furti,

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.4
passages.text: Sive cupis Paphien, seu Ganymede cales,

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.5
passages.text: Maternaeque sacris ornentur frondibus Idus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.6
passages.text: Et senior parca mole prematur avus:

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.7
passages.text: Hunc semper Norbana diem cum coniuge Carpo

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.8
passages.text: Laeta colat, primis quo coiere toris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.9
passages.text: Hic pius antistes sophiae sua dona ministrat,

passages.label: Mart. 7.74.10
passages.text: Hic te ture vocat, fidus et ipse Iovi.

passages.label: Mart. 7.75.1
passages.text: Vis futui gratis, cum sis deformis anusque.

passages.label: Mart. 7.75.2
passages.text: Res perridicula est: vis dare, nec dare vis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.1
passages.text: Quod te diripiunt potentiores

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.2
passages.text: Per convivia, porticus, theatra,

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.3
passages.text: Et tecum, quotiens ita incidisti,

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.4
passages.text: Gestari iuvat et iuvat lavari:

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.5
passages.text: Nolito nimium tibi placere.

passages.label: Mart. 7.76.6
passages.text: Delectas, Philomuse, non amaris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.77.1
passages.text: Exigis, ut nostros donem tibi, Tucca, libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.77.2
passages.text: Non faciam: nam vis vendere, non legere.

passages.label: Mart. 7.78.1
passages.text: Cum Saxetani ponatur coda lacerti

passages.label: Mart. 7.78.2
passages.text: Et, bene si cenas, conchis inuncta tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 7.78.3
passages.text: Sumen, aprum, leporem, boletos, ostrea, mullos

passages.label: Mart. 7.78.4
passages.text: Mittis: habes nec cor, Papyle, nec genium.

passages.label: Mart. 7.79.1
passages.text: Potavi modo consulare vinum.

passages.label: Mart. 7.79.2
passages.text: Quaeris, quam vetus atque liberale?

passages.label: Mart. 7.79.3
passages.text: Prisco consule conditum: sed ipse,

passages.label: Mart. 7.79.4
passages.text: Qui ponebat, erat, Severe, consul.

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.1
passages.text: Quatenus Odrysios iam pax Romana triones

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.2
passages.text: Temperat et tetricae conticuere tubae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.3
passages.text: Hunc Marcellino poteris, Faustine, libellum

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.4
passages.text: Mittere: iam chartis, iam vacat ille iocis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.5
passages.text: Sed si parva tui munuscula quaeris amici

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.6
passages.text: Commendare, ferat carmina nostra puer:

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.7
passages.text: Non qualis Geticae satiatus lacte iuvencae

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.8
passages.text: Sarmatica rigido ludit in amne rota,

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.9
passages.text: Sed Mitylenaei roseus mangonis ephebus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.10
passages.text: Vel non caesus adhuc matre iubente Lacon.

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.11
passages.text: At tibi captivo famulus mittetur ab Histro,

passages.label: Mart. 7.80.12
passages.text: Qui Tiburtinas pascere possit oves.

passages.label: Mart. 7.81.1
passages.text: 'Triginta toto mala sunt epigrammata libro.'

passages.label: Mart. 7.81.2
passages.text: Si totidem bona sunt, Lause, bonus liber est.

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.1
passages.text: Menophili penem tam grandis fibula vestit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.2
passages.text: Ut sit comoedis omnibus una satis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.3
passages.text: Hunc ego credideram—nam saepe lavamur in unum—

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.4
passages.text: Sollicitum voci parcere, Flacce, suae:

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.5
passages.text: Dum ludit media populo spectante palaestra,

passages.label: Mart. 7.82.6
passages.text: Delapsa est misero fibula: verpus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 7.83.1
passages.text: Eutrapelus tonsor dum circuit ora Luperci

passages.label: Mart. 7.83.2
passages.text: Expingitque genas, altera barba subit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.1
passages.text: Dum mea Caecilio formatur imago Secundo

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.2
passages.text: Spirat et arguta picta tabella manu,

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.3
passages.text: I, liber, ad Geticam Peucen Histrumque iacentem:

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.4
passages.text: Haec loca perdomitis gentibus ille tenet.

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.5
passages.text: Parva dabis caro, sed dulcia dona, sodali:

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.6
passages.text: Certior in nostro carmine vultus erit;

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.7
passages.text: Casibus hic nullis, nullis delebilis annis

passages.label: Mart. 7.84.8
passages.text: Vivet, Apelleum cum morietur opus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.85.1
passages.text: Quod non insulse scribis tetrasticha quaedam,

passages.label: Mart. 7.85.2
passages.text: Disticha quod belle pauca, Sabelle, facis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.85.3
passages.text: Laudo, nec admiror. Facile est epigrammata belle

passages.label: Mart. 7.85.4
passages.text: Scribere, sed librum scribere difficile est.

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.1
passages.text: Ad natalicias dapes vocabar,

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.2
passages.text: Essem cum tibi, Sexte, non amicus:

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.3
passages.text: Quid factum est, rogo, quid repente factum est,

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.4
passages.text: Post tot pignora nostra, post tot annos

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.5
passages.text: Quod sum praeteritus vetus sodalis?

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.6
passages.text: Sed causam scio: nulla venit a me

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.7
passages.text: Hispani tibi libra pustulati

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.8
passages.text: Nec levis toga nec rudes lacernae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.9
passages.text: Non est sportula, quae negotiatur;

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.10
passages.text: Pascis munera, Sexte, non amicos.

passages.label: Mart. 7.86.11
passages.text: Iam dices mihi 'Vapulet vocator.'

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.1
passages.text: Si meus aurita gaudet lagalopece Flaccus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.2
passages.text: Si fruitur tristi Canius Aethiope;

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.3
passages.text: Publius exiguae si flagrat amore catellae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.4
passages.text: Si Cronius similem cercopithecon amat;

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.5
passages.text: Delectat Marium si perniciosus ichneumon,

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.6
passages.text: Pica salutatrix si tibi, Lause, placet;

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.7
passages.text: Si gelidum collo nectit Cadilla draconem,

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.8
passages.text: Luscinio tumulum si Telesilla dedit:

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.9
passages.text: Blanda Cupidinei cur non amet ora Labyrtae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.87.10
passages.text: Qui videt haec dominis monstra placere suis?

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.1
passages.text: Fertur habere meos, si vera est fama, libellos

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.2
passages.text: Inter delicias pulchra Vienna suas:

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.3
passages.text: Me legit omnis ibi senior iuvenisque puerque,

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.4
passages.text: Et coram tetrico casta puella viro.

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.5
passages.text: Hoc ego maluerim, quam si mea carmina cantent

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.6
passages.text: Qui Nilum ex ipso protinus ore bibunt;

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.7
passages.text: Quam meus Hispano si me Tagus impleat auro,

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.8
passages.text: Pascat et Hybla meas, pascat Hymettos apes.

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.9
passages.text: Non nihil ergo sumus, nec blandae munere linguae

passages.label: Mart. 7.88.10
passages.text: Decipimur: credam iam, puto, Lause, tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 7.89.1
passages.text: I, felix rosa, mollibusque sertis

passages.label: Mart. 7.89.2
passages.text: Nostri cinge comas Apollinaris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.89.3
passages.text: Quas tu nectere candidas, sed olim—

passages.label: Mart. 7.89.4
passages.text: Sic te semper amet Venus—memento.

passages.label: Mart. 7.90.1
passages.text: Iactat inaequalem Matho me fecisse libellum:

passages.label: Mart. 7.90.2
passages.text: Si verum est, laudat carmina nostra Matho.

passages.label: Mart. 7.90.3
passages.text: Aequales scribit libros Calvinus et Umber:

passages.label: Mart. 7.90.4
passages.text: Aequalis liber est, Cretice, qui malus est.

passages.label: Mart. 7.91.1
passages.text: De nostro, facunde, tibi, Iuvenalis, agello

passages.label: Mart. 7.91.2
passages.text: Saturnalicias mittimus, ecce, nuces.

passages.label: Mart. 7.91.3
passages.text: Cetera lascivis donavit poma puellis

passages.label: Mart. 7.91.4
passages.text: Mentula custodis luxuriosa dei.

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.1
passages.text: 'Si quid opus fuerit, scis me non esse rogandum'

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.2
passages.text: Uno bis dicis, Baccara, terque die.

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.3
passages.text: Appellat rigida tristis me voce Secundus:

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.4
passages.text: Audis, et nescis, Baccara, quid sit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.5
passages.text: Pensio te coram petitur clareque palamque:

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.6
passages.text: Audis, et nescis, Baccara, quid sit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.7
passages.text: Esse queror gelidasque mihi tritasque lacernas:

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.8
passages.text: Audis, et nescis, Baccara, quid sit opus.

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.9
passages.text: Hoc opus est, subito fias ut sidere mutus,

passages.label: Mart. 7.92.10
passages.text: Dicere ne possis, Baccara: 'Si quid opus'.

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.1
passages.text: Narnia, sulphureo quam gurgite candidus amnis

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.2
passages.text: Circuit, ancipiti vix adeunda iugo,

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.3
passages.text: Quid tam saepe meum nobis abducere Quintum

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.4
passages.text: Te iuvat et lenta detinuisse mora?

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.5
passages.text: Quid Nomentani causam mihi perdis agelli,

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.6
passages.text: Propter vicinum qui pretiosus erat?

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.7
passages.text: Sed iam parce mihi nec abutere, Narnia, Quinto:

passages.label: Mart. 7.93.8
passages.text: Perpetuo liceat sic tibi ponte frui.

passages.label: Mart. 7.94.1
passages.text: Unguentum fuerat, quod onyx modo parva gerebat:

passages.label: Mart. 7.94.2
passages.text: Olfecit postquam Papylus, ecce, garum est.

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.1
passages.text: Bruma est et riget horridus December,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.2
passages.text: Audes tu tamen osculo nivali

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.3
passages.text: Omnes obvius hinc et hinc tenere

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.4
passages.text: Et totam, Line, basiare Romam.

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.5
passages.text: Quid posses graviusque saeviusque

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.6
passages.text: Percussus facere atque verberatus?

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.7
passages.text: Hoc me frigore basiet nec uxor,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.8
passages.text: Blandis filia nec rudis labellis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.9
passages.text: Sed tu dulcior elegantiorque,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.10
passages.text: Cuius livida naribus caninis

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.11
passages.text: Dependet glacies rigetque barba,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.12
passages.text: Qualem forficibus metit supinis

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.13
passages.text: Tonsor Cinyphio Cilix marito.

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.14
passages.text: Centum occurrere malo cunnilingis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.15
passages.text: Et Gallum timeo minus recentem.

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.16
passages.text: Quare si tibi sensus est pudorque,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.17
passages.text: Hibernas, Line, basiationes,

passages.label: Mart. 7.95.18
passages.text: In mensem rogo differas Aprilem.

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.1
passages.text: Conditus hic ego sum, Bassi dolor, Urbicus infans,

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.2
passages.text: Cui genus et nomen maxima Roma dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.3
passages.text: Sex mihi de prima deerant trieteride menses,

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.4
passages.text: Ruperunt tetricae cum male pensa deae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.5
passages.text: Quid species, quid lingua mihi, quid profuit aetas?

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.6
passages.text: Da lacrimas tumulo, qui legis ista, meo:

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.7
passages.text: Sic ad Lethaeas, nisi Nestore serior, undas

passages.label: Mart. 7.96.8
passages.text: Non eat, optabis quem superesse tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.1
passages.text: Nosti si bene Caesium, libelle,

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.2
passages.text: Montanae decus Umbriae Sabinum,

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.3
passages.text: Auli municipem mei Pudentis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.4
passages.text: Illi tu dabis haec vel occupato:

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.5
passages.text: Instent mille licet premantque curae,

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.6
passages.text: Nostris carminibus tamen vacabit:

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.7
passages.text: Nam me diligit ille proximumque

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.8
passages.text: Turni nobilibus legit libellis.

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.9
passages.text: O quantum tibi nominis paratur!

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.10
passages.text: O quae gloria! quam frequens amator!

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.11
passages.text: Te convivia, te forum sonabit,

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.12
passages.text: Aedes, compita, porticus, tabernae.

passages.label: Mart. 7.97.13
passages.text: Uni mitteris, omnibus legeris.

passages.label: Mart. 7.98.1
passages.text: Omnia, Castor, emis: sic fiet, ut omnia vendas.

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.1
passages.text: Sic placidum videas semper, Crispine, Tonantem,

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.2
passages.text: Nec te Roma minus, quam tua Memphis amet:

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.3
passages.text: Carmina Parrhasia si nostra legentur in aula

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.4
passages.text: —Namque solent sacra Caesaris aure frui—,

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.5
passages.text: Dicere de nobis, ut lector candidus, aude:

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.6
passages.text: 'Temporibus praestat non nihil iste tuis,

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.7
passages.text: Nec Marso nimium minor est doctoque Catullo.'

passages.label: Mart. 7.99.8
passages.text: Hoc satis est: ipsi cetera mando deo.
